title: Green Circle TD
description: Maze tower defense: creeps circle in from four corners to the center, passing every position. Procedural turret + creep graphics, tower progression with Lv1-3 upgrades and 2-way specializations, armor-vs-damage matrix including WC3 chaos damage, air-targeting restriction (anti-air towers only), randomized wave order, distinct creep visual archetypes per enemy type, local 1–4 player hot-seat co-op with zone ownership, aura towers, Mint economy tower, interest economy, wave benchmarks, stackable waves, 1×/2×/3× speed, pause/restart, and 30 escalating waves to a multi-phase boss.
